articles.title: Netherlands Seizes 800 Servers, Arrests 2 for Aiding Cyberattacks
articles.summary: Meta's AI support bot got socially engineered harder than a freshman at DEF CON, leading to the Obama White House Instagram getting slapped with pro-Iranian memes. When the machines become the weakest link, you know we've truly entered the stupidest timeline.

articles.title: Internet Age-Gates Are a Growing Global Threat
articles.summary: CISA contractor casually dumped AWS GovCloud keys on GitHub like it's their personal dotfiles repo. The agency supposedly protecting our infrastructure just handed out the keys to the kingdom on the world's most public code dump.

articles.title: EFF Testifies to Congress on Protecting Americans’ Rights from Government AI
articles.summary: Trump's unqualified DNI appointment perfectly illustrates why Section 702's warrantless mass surveillance needs to die. When political hacks control the panopticon, constitutional rights become suggestions.

articles.title: World Food Programme breach exposes data of 600k vulnerable Gazan families
articles.summary: Another Cisco SD-WAN zero-day is getting actively exploited with no patch in sight. Cisco's patch timeline operates on geological scales while attackers move at internet speed.

articles.title: AI Agent Uncovers 21 Zero-Days in FFmpeg; Chrome Patches Record 429 Bugs
articles.summary: CISA added a SolarWinds Serv-U DoS flaw to their Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog because apparently SolarWinds wasn't done embarrassing itself. Some wounds never heal, they just keep reopening.

articles.title: Miasma Worm Hits 73 Microsoft GitHub Repositories in Major Supply Chain Attack
articles.summary: An AI agent just pwned FFmpeg with 21 zero-days while Chrome patched a record 429 bugs in one release. The robots are getting scary good at breaking things, and humans are getting scary bad at fixing them fast enough.

articles.title: Zcash faces governance concerns after emergency hard fork over critical vulnerability
articles.summary: Claude Opus discovered a four-year-old critical flaw in Zcash that could enable undetectable counterfeiting. An AI found what human auditors missed for years, proving our new robot overlords might actually be useful.

articles.title: Two men shot at Trump's Butler rally sue federal government over Secret Service 'preventable failures'
articles.summary: University of Toronto researchers built an autonomous AI worm that can reason and adapt its attack strategies. Finally, malware that can think for itself — what could possibly go wrong?

articles.title: CBSE retains COEMPT for answer-sheet scanning, shifts data to its own servers
articles.summary: Former IBM cybersecurity exec blows the whistle on years of covered-up Chinese state hacking. Big Blue got pwned repeatedly and decided the best security strategy was pretending it never happened.

articles.title: Cisco SD-WAN Has a New Root-Level Problem, and There’s No Fix Yet
articles.summary: CISA confirms hackers are actively exploiting that SolarWinds Serv-U flaw to crash servers. SolarWinds: the gift that keeps on giving, like herpes but for your network infrastructure.
